AdminUserCreateRequest.title: AdminUserCreateRequest
AdminUserCreateRequest.description:

(`user-management.md`, Create User (Admin)).

`password` intentionally carries no length constraint at this layer:
the 16-128 character policy is domain validation enforced by
`user_service.create_user()`, which raises the domain-specific
`PasswordValidationError` mapped to `422
USER_PASSWORD_POLICY_VIOLATION` — a schema constraint here would
instead produce the generic `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`, losing that
documented code (mirrors `ApiKeyCreateRequest.name`).

AdminUserUpdateRequest.title: AdminUserUpdateRequest
AdminUserUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for `PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{user}`
(`user-management.md`, Update User (Admin)).

Both fields are optional but at least one must be provided
(`docs/api-spec.md`, Partial Update Semantics). `email` rejects
explicit `null` (non-nullable field); `full_name` accepts explicit
`null` to clear the stored display name. The route distinguishes
"omitted" from "explicitly provided" via `model_fields_set` — see
`docs/features/identity/user-service.md` (`update_user()`, the
`_MISSING` sentinel pattern) for how the route threads this into the
service call.

ApiKeyCreateRequest.title: ApiKeyCreateRequest
ApiKeyCreateRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/api-keys`.

`name` intentionally carries no length/charset constraint: the API
Key Name Rule (trim, lowercase, 1-128 characters, `[a-z0-9._-]`) is
applied and enforced by `api_key_service.create_key()`, which
raises the domain-specific `ApiKeyNameValidationError` — a schema
constraint here would instead produce the generic
`422 VALIDATION_ERROR`, losing the documented
`AUTH_API_KEY_NAME_INVALID` code.

deregistered fetcher — see `docs/features/platform/fetcher-operations.md`

FetcherConfigUpdateRequest.title: FetcherConfigUpdateRequest
FetcherConfigUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for `PATCH /api/v1/fetchers/{fetcher_name}/config`
(`fetcher-operations.md`, Update Fetcher Config).

All fields are optional but at least one must be provided
(`docs/api-spec.md`, Partial Update Semantics). The route
distinguishes "omitted" from "explicitly provided" via
`model_fields_set` (see `AdminUserUpdateRequest` for the same
pattern). `enabled`, `run_timeout`, and `request_delay` are
non-nullable in the data model — an explicit `null` for any of
them is rejected here, before the service is called.
`schedule_override` accepts `null` to revert to the fetcher's
`default_schedule`. `custom_settings`, when provided, cannot itself
be `null` (the JSONB column is non-nullable) — but an individual
key *within* it may be `null`, resetting that key to its
`Settings` field default (`fetcher-operations.md`,
`update_fetcher_config`, step 6). Per-key/per-value validation
(unknown key, invalid value) is performed by the service layer,
which raises the dedicated `FetcherSettingUnknownError`/
`FetcherSettingInvalidError` (422
`FETCHER_SETTING_UNKNOWN`/`FETCHER_SETTING_INVALID`) — this schema
only validates the group-level shape and the input-only
constraints (`docs/features/platform/fetcher-operations.md`,
`update_fetcher_config`, Q3 step 1) that must produce the generic
`422 VALIDATION_ERROR`: `schedule_override` cron syntax and
50-character storage bound (matching `FetcherConfig.schedule_override`,
`VARCHAR(50)`), and the `run_timeout`/`request_delay` numeric bounds.
`enabled`, `run_timeout`, and `request_delay` accept only their JSON
type without coercion (`docs/api-spec.md`, JSON Request Body Scalar
Types): a JSON integer is still a valid `request_delay`, but `600.0`
is not a valid `run_timeout`.

FetcherDisabledPeriodData.description:
One derived disabled period. `disabled_by`/`enabled_by` are
`UserReference` objects only when the caller holds
`manage_fetchers`, otherwise `null` — never absent (unlike the run
detail's raw diagnostic fields), since these are always meaningful

FetcherLastRunData.title: FetcherLastRunData
FetcherLastRunData.description:
The `last_run` object nested in a `List Fetchers` item.

`triggered_by_user` is a `UserReference` when `triggered_by` is
`manual` and the caller holds `manage_fetchers`, otherwise `null`.
`error_detail`/`error_traceback` are never included at this level
(list response) — see `docs/features/platform/fetcher-operations.md`
(List Fetchers, Fields).

FetcherListItemData.title: FetcherListItemData
FetcherListItemData.description:
One entry in the `GET /api/v1/fetchers` response — a registered
or deregistered fetcher merged with its latest run and, when
applicable, its next scheduled run time.

FetcherListResponse.title: FetcherListResponse
FetcherListResponse.description:
Response body for `GET /api/v1/fetchers`. Not paginated — see
`docs/features/platform/fetcher-operations.md` (List Fetchers,
Pagination).

FetcherRunDetailData.title: FetcherRunDetailData
FetcherRunDetailData.description:
The `data` object for `GET /api/v1/fetchers/{fetcher_name}/runs/{run_id}`.

`error_detail`/`error_traceback` default to unset. The endpoint
constructs this model without passing them for callers lacking

FetcherRunListItemData.title: FetcherRunListItemData
FetcherRunListItemData.description:
One entry in the `GET /api/v1/fetchers/{fetcher_name}/runs`
response — the same shape as `FetcherLastRunData` plus
`fetcher_name` (needed here since a run list item is not already

FetcherTimelinePointData.title: FetcherTimelinePointData
FetcherTimelinePointData.description: One chart data point — a single `FetcherRun` record.

FetcherTriggerData.title: FetcherTriggerData
FetcherTriggerData.description:

Trigger Fetcher). `run_id` identifies a `FetcherRun` already

HealthCheckStatus.title: HealthCheckStatus
HealthCheckStatus.description:
Result value of a single readiness dependency check.

Category B — classification (Python Enum only; never stored in the
database — readiness results are never persisted). See
`docs/features/platform/health-endpoints.md` (Check result values,

IBSConsumerErrorCategory.description:

IBSConsumerStatus.description:
Status of the IBS RabbitMQ consumer process.

`docs/features/integrations/ibs-rabbitmq-integration.md` (Consumer
States).

status.description: `connected`, `disconnected`, or `reconnecting` from a valid fresh heartbeat; `disabled` when the consumer is configured off; `unreachable` when liveness cannot be established from a valid fresh heartbeat.

heartbeat_at.title: Heartbeat At
heartbeat_at.description: Time the heartbeat was written; `null` without a heartbeat.

process_started_at.description: Start time of the consumer process.

last_error.description: Most recent bounded error category of this process.

IBSConsumerStatusData.title: IBSConsumerStatusData
IBSConsumerStatusData.description: The observed status of the IBS RabbitMQ consumer process.

MaintainerTicketWork.description:

superseded_by_request_number.description: Request number of the successor when `state` is `superseded`; otherwise `null`.

package_name.title: Package Name
package_name.description: Logical source package of the action.

codestream_name.title: Codestream Name
codestream_name.description: IBS codestream (track reference) the submission targets.

incident_number.title: Incident Number
incident_number.description: Maintenance incident the submission created or updated; `null` until IBS establishes it.

ibs_url.title: Ibs Url
ibs_url.description: IBS web link of the request.

incident_url.title: Incident Url
incident_url.description: IBS web link of the incident project; `null` without an incident.

upstream_updated_at.title: Upstream Updated At
upstream_updated_at.description: Time (UTC) of the current IBS request state.

SystemSettingsData.title: SystemSettingsData
SystemSettingsData.description:
The settings object returned by `GET` and `PATCH
/api/v1/admin/settings`.

TicketAccessGrantListResponse.title: TicketAccessGrantListResponse
TicketAccessGrantListResponse.description:
Response body of `GET /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/access`.

Unpaginated (no `meta`): explicit grants per Ticket are a bounded
dataset. Items are in the fixed order `granted_at ASC, user.id ASC`,
which is not client-configurable.

user.title: User
user.description: Target user: UUID or exact username. Creating a new grant requires an active user; an existing grant is returned unchanged even when its user is inactive. Required.

TicketAccessGrantRequest.title: TicketAccessGrantRequest
TicketAccessGrantRequest.description:
Request body of `POST /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/access`.

See `docs/features/tickets/tickets.md` (Grant Access). `user` is a
required, non-nullable UUID-or-username string (`docs/api-spec.md`,
User Identifier Resolution), passed unchanged to the service, which
locks the target before the Ticket but reports its absence only after
locked-current Ticket accessibility and the confidentiality guard. An
omitted, `null`, or non-string field fails with the global
`422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

user.description: Current profile of the user holding the grant, including `active = false` when deactivated.

granted_by.description: Current profile of the user who created the grant.

TicketAccessGrantResponse.title: TicketAccessGrantResponse
TicketAccessGrantResponse.description:
One explicit access grant (`docs/features/tickets/tickets.md`,
TicketAccessGrantResponse).

Both user references are complete current profiles (`docs/api-spec.md`,
User References in Responses): a deactivated user is projected with
`active = false`, and neither inactivity nor reactivation rewrites the
grant's provenance.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Target user: UUID or exact username. The user must be active and hold the `vulnerability_analyst` role. Required; `null` is rejected (no unassignment through the API).

TicketAssigneeUpdateRequest.title: TicketAssigneeUpdateRequest
TicketAssigneeUpdateRequest.description:
Request body of `PATCH /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/assignee`.

See `docs/features/tickets/tickets.md` (Assign Ticket). `user_id` is a
required, non-nullable UUID-or-username string (`docs/api-spec.md`,
User Identifier Resolution): a Ticket cannot be unassigned through the
API. The service locks the target before the Ticket but reports its
absence only after locked-current Ticket accessibility. An omitted,
`null`, or non-string field fails with the global
`422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

cve_id.title: Cve Id
cve_id.description: CVE identifier to associate (e.g. `CVE-2024-1234`), matching `^CVE-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4,}$` with at most 20 characters; otherwise `422 CVE_INVALID_FORMAT`. An unknown CVE is created as a placeholder record. Required.

TicketAssociateCVERequest.title: TicketAssociateCVERequest
TicketAssociateCVERequest.description:
Request body of `POST /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/associate-cve`.

See `docs/features/tickets/tickets.md` (Associate CVE). `cve_id` is
required and carries no schema length limit, so any string — including
an empty or over-length one — reaches the endpoint's
`422 CVE_INVALID_FORMAT` check. A missing, `null`, or non-string value
fails with the global `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

TicketAuditEventData.title: TicketAuditEventData
TicketAuditEventData.description:
One Ticket audit event.

`ticket_id` is the parent's canonical `SNTL-{n}` identity; the
internal Ticket UUID is never exposed (`docs/api-spec.md`, Ticket
Identifier Resolution). `id` is the event's own UUID. `actor` is the
complete current User reference, or `null` for a system event.

existing_ticket_id.title: Existing Ticket Id
existing_ticket_id.description: Canonical identity (`SNTL-{n}`) of the Ticket already associated with the CVE. Only for `TICKET_CVE_CONFLICT`; it is returned even when that Ticket is otherwise inaccessible, and following it applies ordinary accessibility (identifier only, no Ticket content).

TicketCVEConflictErrorResponse.title: TicketCVEConflictErrorResponse

is_confidential.title: Is Confidential
is_confidential.description: Requested confidentiality. `false` on a confidential Ticket declassifies it and deletes every explicit access grant; `true` never recreates grants. The same value as the current one is a no-op. Required.

TicketConfidentialityUpdateRequest.title: TicketConfidentialityUpdateRequest
TicketConfidentialityUpdateRequest.description:
Request body of `PATCH /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/confidentiality`.

See `docs/features/tickets/tickets.md` (Set Confidentiality). The
single field is required and non-nullable (`docs/api-spec.md`, Partial
Update Semantics: single-field PATCH; `Ticket.is_confidential` is
non-nullable). An omitted field, `null`, or any value other than a
JSON boolean (`docs/api-spec.md`, JSON Request Body Scalar Types)
fails with the global `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
ticket_id.description: Canonical external identity of the accessible Ticket.

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: Transient Celery ID of the newly published root convergence task.

TicketConvergenceDispatchResponse.title: TicketConvergenceDispatchResponse
TicketConvergenceDispatchResponse.description:
The accepted Ticket convergence rerun
(`docs/features/tickets/tickets.md`, TicketConvergenceDispatchResponse).

`task_id` is correlation data only: not a durable run resource, with
no status or progress endpoint, and not a `FetcherRun` identifier.

coordinated_release_at.title: Coordinated Release At
coordinated_release_at.description: Coordinated Release Date (embargo publication instant), an ISO 8601 date-time, or JSON `null` to clear it. A value without a UTC offset is interpreted as UTC; an offset is converted to UTC. Past instants are accepted. Required.

TicketCoordinatedReleaseDateUpdateReques.title: TicketCoordinatedReleaseDateUpdateRequest
TicketCoordinatedReleaseDateUpdateReques.description:
Request body of
`PATCH /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/coordinated-release-date`.

See `docs/features/tickets/tickets.md` (Set Coordinated Release Date).
The single field is required and nullable (`docs/api-spec.md`, Partial
Update Semantics: single-field PATCH): an ISO 8601 date-time sets or
replaces the CRD, JSON `null` clears it. The value is parsed by the
shared `parse_coordinated_release_at()`, so it accepts exactly the
inputs of `POST /api/v1/tickets`. An omitted field or a non-datetime
value fails with the global `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

cve_id.title: Cve Id
cve_id.description: CVE identifier to associate (e.g. `CVE-2024-1234`), matching `^CVE-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4,}$` with at most 20 characters; otherwise `422 CVE_INVALID_FORMAT`. An empty string is rejected the same way: omit the field or send `null` for no CVE. An unknown CVE is created as a placeholder record.

severity.description: Initial manual severity: `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, or `none` (CVSS score 0.0, informational). Omitted or `null` leaves it unresolved. Not allowed together with `cve_id` (`409 TICKET_SEVERITY_DERIVED`): severity is then derived from CVSS.

is_confidential.title: Is Confidential
is_confidential.description: Create the Ticket as confidential. When present (`true` or `false`), the caller also needs the `manage_confidentiality` capability; otherwise `403 AUTH_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION`. Default `false`.

coordinated_release_at.title: Coordinated Release At
coordinated_release_at.description: Initial Coordinated Release Date (embargo publication instant), an ISO 8601 date-time. Accepted only with `is_confidential: true`. A value without a UTC offset is interpreted as UTC; an offset is converted to UTC. Past instants are accepted. Omitted or `null` creates the Ticket without a CRD.

TicketCreateRequest.title: TicketCreateRequest
TicketCreateRequest.description:
Request body of `POST /api/v1/tickets`.

See `docs/features/tickets/tickets.md` (Create Ticket). Every field is
optional. `cve_id` carries no schema length limit, so any string —
including an empty or over-length one — reaches the endpoint's
`422 CVE_INVALID_FORMAT` check. The endpoint distinguishes an omitted
`is_confidential` from an explicit `false` through `model_fields_set`
(the field-level `manage_confidentiality` check is presence-based);
the field accepts only a JSON boolean (`docs/api-spec.md`, JSON
Request Body Scalar Types). A non-null `coordinated_release_at`
without `is_confidential: true` fails with the global
`422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

severity.description: Resolved severity (the CVE severity for a Ticket with a CVE, otherwise the manual severity): `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, or `none` (CVSS score 0.0, informational), or `null` when unresolved (no CVSS data and no manual severity set). `none` is distinct from `null`.

priority.description: Effective priority: `priority_override` when set, otherwise `priority_automatic`. `p1`-`p4`, or `null` when not yet prioritizable.

priority_automatic.description: System-derived priority: `p1`-`p4`, or `null` when not yet prioritizable.

priority_override.description: Manual priority override: `p1`-`p4`, or `null` when no override is set.

assignee.description: Assigned Vulnerability Analyst, or `null` if unassigned.

cve.description: Expanded data of the associated CVE, or `null` if no CVE.

duplicate_of_ticket_id.title: Duplicate Of Ticket Id
duplicate_of_ticket_id.description: Canonical identity (`SNTL-{n}`) of the Ticket this Ticket duplicates, or `null`. Only the identifier is exposed: following it applies ordinary accessibility and may return `404 TICKET_NOT_FOUND`.

coordinated_release_at.title: Coordinated Release At
coordinated_release_at.description: Coordinated Release Date (embargo publication instant, UTC), or `null` when none is set.

triage_due_at.title: Triage Due At
triage_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the triage milestone, in which the VA (Vulnerability Analyst) decides affectedness; `null` when no SLA applies (Ticket `ignored` or `duplicated`, or severity `none`).

submission_due_at.title: Submission Due At
submission_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the submission milestone, in which the maintainer prepares the fix and submits it to IBS (submission request, SR).

um_due_at.title: Um Due At
um_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the UM milestone, in which the UM (SUSE maintenance update team) prepares the maintenance update and creates the release request (RR).

qa_due_at.title: Qa Due At
qa_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the QA milestone, in which QA (quality assurance) tests the maintenance update before publication; currently equal to `release_due_at`.

release_due_at.title: Release Due At
release_due_at.description: Final deadline (UTC) by which the update must be released; currently equal to `qa_due_at`.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Complete package/track/Product tree, including excluded and non-actionable records, ordered by `package_name` (Unicode code point). Maintainer identities are not exposed.

TicketDetail.title: TicketDetail
TicketDetail.description:
Full Ticket representation for the detail endpoint and every
mutation endpoint returning a Ticket.

Replaces the compact `package_names` of list views with the complete
package tree and uses expanded CVE data. Maintainer identities are
never exposed.

duplicate_of_ticket_id.title: Duplicate Of Ticket Id
duplicate_of_ticket_id.description: Canonical identity (`SNTL-{n}`) of the target Ticket, which must not itself be Duplicated. Malformed syntax fails validation; a missing or inaccessible target returns `404 TICKET_NOT_FOUND`. Required.

TicketDuplicateRequest.title: TicketDuplicateRequest
TicketDuplicateRequest.description:
Request body of `POST /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/duplicate`.

See `docs/features/tickets/tickets.md` (Mark Ticket as Duplicate) and
`docs/api-spec.md` (Ticket Identifier Resolution): a request-body
Ticket field uses the canonical `SNTL-{n}` grammar with ordinary
Pydantic semantics, so a missing, `null`, non-string, or malformed
value (lowercase prefix, whitespace, zero padding, overflow, a
Ticket UUID, ...) fails with the global `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`. A
well-formed target that is missing or inaccessible is a
`404 TICKET_NOT_FOUND` decided by the service, not here.

TicketPackageListResponse.title: TicketPackageListResponse
TicketPackageListResponse.description:
Response body for `GET /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/packages`.

Unpaginated: the package count per Ticket is bounded.

severity.description: Resolved Ticket severity (the CVE severity for a Ticket with a CVE, otherwise the manual severity): `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, or `none` (CVSS score 0.0, informational), or `null` when unresolved. `none` is distinct from `null`.

TicketPackageRef.title: TicketPackageRef
TicketPackageRef.description: Lightweight reference to the Ticket of a package occurrence.

priority.description: Manual priority override: `p1`, `p2`, `p3`, or `p4` sets it; JSON `null` clears it and returns the Ticket to its automatic priority. Required.

TicketPriorityUpdateRequest.title: TicketPriorityUpdateRequest
TicketPriorityUpdateRequest.description:
Request body of `PATCH /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/priority`.

See `docs/features/tickets/tickets.md` (Set Priority Override). The
single field is required and nullable (`docs/api-spec.md`, Partial
Update Semantics: single-field PATCH): a lowercase level sets or
changes the override, while JSON `null` clears it. An omitted field
or any other value fails with the global `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

url.title: Url
url.description: Absolute `http` or `https` URL with a valid host and no user information or control characters, at most 2048 characters before and after normalization. Stored normalized: scheme and host lowercased, `http` upgraded to `https`, and only an otherwise empty root path slash removed. Never dereferenced.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable label: 1-500 characters, not whitespace-only, not trimmed. Omitted or `null` stores no title.

description.title: Description
description.description: Editorial context: 1-2000 characters, not whitespace-only, not trimmed. Omitted or `null` stores no description.

type.description: `advisory`, `patch`, `issue`, or `article`. Omitted: classified from the normalized URL, or uncategorized when no pattern matches. `null`: stored uncategorized without classification.

TicketReferenceCreate.title: TicketReferenceCreate
TicketReferenceCreate.description:
Request body of `POST /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/references`.

`url` is required and non-nullable. Omitted or `null` `title` and
`description` persist as `NULL`. An omitted `type` requests
URL-pattern classification; an explicit `null` stores uncategorized.

TicketReferenceDataResponse.title: TicketReferenceDataResponse
TicketReferenceDataResponse.description: Response body of `POST` and `PATCH` on Ticket references.

TicketReferenceListResponse.title: TicketReferenceListResponse
TicketReferenceListResponse.description:
Response body of `GET /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/references`.

Unpaginated: references are a small Ticket-scoped collection.

source.title: Source
source.description: `manual` for consumer-managed references; otherwise the stable name of the CVE fetcher that owns the reference (not editable).

url.title: Url
url.description: Absolute `http` or `https` URL with a valid host and no user information or control characters, at most 2048 characters before and after normalization. Stored normalized: scheme and host lowercased, `http` upgraded to `https`, and only an otherwise empty root path slash removed. Never dereferenced. Omitted preserves; `null` is invalid.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable label: 1-500 characters, not whitespace-only, not trimmed. Omitted preserves; `null` clears.

description.title: Description
description.description: Editorial context: 1-2000 characters, not whitespace-only, not trimmed. Omitted preserves; `null` clears.

type.description: `advisory`, `patch`, `issue`, or `article`. Omitted preserves (also when `url` changes); `null` clears to uncategorized.

TicketReferenceUpdate.title: TicketReferenceUpdate
TicketReferenceUpdate.description:
Request body of `PATCH .../references/{reference_id}`.

Partial update (`docs/api-spec.md`, Partial Update Semantics): an
omitted field preserves the current value; `null` clears `title`,
`description`, or `type`; `url` rejects `null`. An empty object is
rejected. Changing `url` without `type` preserves the current type.

severity.description: Manual severity: `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, or `none` (CVSS score 0.0, informational) sets the value; JSON `null` clears it (unresolved). Required.

TicketSeverityUpdateRequest.title: TicketSeverityUpdateRequest
TicketSeverityUpdateRequest.description:
Request body of `PATCH /api/v1/tickets/{ticket_id}/severity`.

See `docs/features/tickets/tickets.md` (Set Severity Manual). The single
field is required and nullable (`docs/api-spec.md`, Partial Update
Semantics: single-field PATCH): a lowercase label sets the manual
severity, while JSON `null` clears it. An omitted field or any other
value fails with the global `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

TicketSortField.title: TicketSortField
TicketSortField.description:
Sortable fields for the Ticket list query.

Category B — classification (Python Enum only; never stored in the
database). See `docs/features/tickets/tickets.md` (List Tickets) and
`docs/features/tickets/ticket-service.md` (`list_tickets()`):
`severity`, `priority`, and `status` use semantic ranks, `ticket_id`
sorts by the numeric `sequence_id`, and the five due dates sort by
the Ticket-level date with `NULL` last
(`docs/features/tickets/ticket-deadlines.md`, Sorting).

severity.description: Resolved severity (the CVE severity for a Ticket with a CVE, otherwise the manual severity): `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, or `none` (CVSS score 0.0, informational), or `null` when unresolved (no CVSS data and no manual severity set). `none` is distinct from `null`.

priority.description: Effective priority: `priority_override` when set, otherwise `priority_automatic`. `p1`-`p4`, or `null` when not yet prioritizable.

assignee.description: Assigned Vulnerability Analyst, or `null` if unassigned.

cve.description: Summary of the associated CVE, or `null` if no CVE.

duplicate_of_ticket_id.title: Duplicate Of Ticket Id
duplicate_of_ticket_id.description: Canonical identity (`SNTL-{n}`) of the Ticket this Ticket duplicates, or `null`. Only the identifier is exposed: following it applies ordinary accessibility and may return `404 TICKET_NOT_FOUND`.

coordinated_release_at.title: Coordinated Release At
coordinated_release_at.description: Coordinated Release Date (embargo publication instant, UTC), or `null` when none is set. A retained value on a non-confidential Ticket is historical and inert.

triage_due_at.title: Triage Due At
triage_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the triage milestone, in which the VA (Vulnerability Analyst) decides affectedness; `null` when no SLA applies (Ticket `ignored` or `duplicated`, or severity `none`).

submission_due_at.title: Submission Due At
submission_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the submission milestone, in which the maintainer prepares the fix and submits it to IBS (submission request, SR).

um_due_at.title: Um Due At
um_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the UM milestone, in which the UM (SUSE maintenance update team) prepares the maintenance update and creates the release request (RR).

qa_due_at.title: Qa Due At
qa_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the QA milestone, in which QA (quality assurance) tests the maintenance update before publication; currently equal to `release_due_at`.

release_due_at.title: Release Due At
release_due_at.description: Final deadline (UTC) by which the update must be released; currently equal to `qa_due_at`.

package_names.title: Package Names
package_names.description: Exact-deduplicated names of the directly included packages, ordered by ascending Unicode code point. Product lifecycle actionability does not remove an included package name.

TicketSummary.title: TicketSummary
TicketSummary.description:
Compact Ticket representation returned by the list endpoint.

Provides enough information for table views without the package
tree: `package_names` replaces it with the included package names.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Codestream project name or branch reference.

delivery_status.description: Delivery pipeline status: `pending`, `in_progress`, or `released`. `pending` is the system default: it does not imply that a fix is expected, does not prove that no submission request exists, and does not establish that synchronization succeeded. Use `delivery_relevant` to decide whether this value is operationally significant.

delivery_relevant.title: Delivery Relevant
delivery_relevant.description: Computed: `true` when the affectedness is `analysis` or `affected`, or `delivery_status` is not `pending`. When `false`, consumers should not display `delivery_status` or make decisions based on it.

products.title: Products
products.description: Product occurrences under this track, including excluded and non-actionable ones, ordered by `product_cpe` (Unicode code point).

deleted_at.title: Deleted At
deleted_at.description: Direct manual-exclusion timestamp of this track only; `null` when not directly excluded.

actionable.title: Actionable
actionable.description: Whether the track is not manually excluded (directly or through its package) and has at least one actionable Product.

non_actionable_reason.description: First applicable reason in the order `package_excluded`, `track_excluded`, `no_actionable_products`; `null` when actionable.

triage_due_at.title: Triage Due At
triage_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the VA (Vulnerability Analyst) triage milestone for this track; `null` when no SLA applies (Ticket `ignored` or `duplicated`, or severity `none`).

submission_due_at.title: Submission Due At
submission_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the maintainer submission (SR) milestone.

um_due_at.title: Um Due At
um_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the UM (SUSE maintenance update team) release-request (RR) milestone.

qa_due_at.title: Qa Due At
qa_due_at.description: Due date (UTC) of the QA (quality assurance) milestone; currently equal to `release_due_at`.

release_due_at.title: Release Due At
release_due_at.description: Final deadline (UTC) by which the update must be released; currently equal to `qa_due_at`.

milestones.description: Per-phase milestone status of this track.

current_phase.description: First phase not yet completed, in the order `triage` (VA), `submission` (maintainer), `um` (UM), `qa` (QA); `done` when every applicable phase is completed; `null` when no SLA applies or an unobservable (`null`) phase is reached before any pending or overdue phase. `pending` and `overdue` are never phases.

TrackDetail.title: TrackDetail
TrackDetail.description: One track (IBS codestream or Git branch) within a package.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Track reference (codestream project name or branch).

actionable.title: Actionable
actionable.description: Whether the track is not manually excluded (directly or through its package) and has at least one actionable Product, on the mutation's UTC evaluation date.

non_actionable_reason.description: First applicable reason in the order `package_excluded`, `track_excluded`, `no_actionable_products`; `null` when actionable.

TrackExclusionTrack.title: TrackExclusionTrack
TrackExclusionTrack.description: The locked-current track returned by a track exclude or restore.

triage.description: Triage phase: the VA (Vulnerability Analyst) decides the affectedness of the track. `done` (completed), `pending` (not completed and its due date is not past), `overdue` (not completed and its due date is past), `not_applicable` (the phase does not apply to this track), or `null` (no SLA applies, or Sentinel cannot observe the phase for this track, such as a Git track or a Ticket without a CVE). A milestone `pending` is unrelated to `delivery_status = pending`.

submission.description: Submission phase: the maintainer prepares the fix and submits it to IBS as a submission request (SR). `done` (completed), `pending` (not completed and its due date is not past), `overdue` (not completed and its due date is past), `not_applicable` (the phase does not apply to this track), or `null` (no SLA applies, or Sentinel cannot observe the phase for this track, such as a Git track or a Ticket without a CVE). A milestone `pending` is unrelated to `delivery_status = pending`.

um.description: UM phase: the UM (SUSE maintenance update team) prepares the maintenance update and creates the release request (RR). `done` (completed), `pending` (not completed and its due date is not past), `overdue` (not completed and its due date is past), `not_applicable` (the phase does not apply to this track), or `null` (no SLA applies, or Sentinel cannot observe the phase for this track, such as a Git track or a Ticket without a CVE). A milestone `pending` is unrelated to `delivery_status = pending`.

qa.description: QA phase: QA (quality assurance) tests the maintenance update, which is then published to every actionable eligible Product. `done` (completed), `pending` (not completed and its due date is not past), `overdue` (not completed and its due date is past), `not_applicable` (the phase does not apply to this track), or `null` (no SLA applies, or Sentinel cannot observe the phase for this track, such as a Git track or a Ticket without a CVE). A milestone `pending` is unrelated to `delivery_status = pending`.

TrackMilestones.title: TrackMilestones
TrackMilestones.description:
Milestone status per phase of one track.

Each member is one of: done, pending, overdue, not_applicable, or
null. A milestone `pending` is unrelated to `delivery_status = pending`.

product_cpe.title: Product Cpe
product_cpe.description: Canonical public identity (CPE) of the related catalog Product.

eligible.title: Eligible

is_eligible_override.title: Is Eligible Override

lifecycle_phase.description: Product lifecycle phase for the mutation's UTC evaluation date; `null` when lifecycle data is unavailable.

actionable.title: Actionable
actionable.description: Whether the Product currently participates in operational decisions: no manual exclusion at package, track, or Product level, and not end-of-life.

non_actionable_reason.description: First applicable reason in the order `package_excluded`, `track_excluded`, `product_excluded`, `eol`; `null` when actionable.

TrackStatusProduct.description: One Product occurrence of a track-status mutation response.

reference.description: Codestream project name or branch reference.

actionable.description: Whether the track is not manually excluded (directly or through its package) and has at least one actionable Product.

non_actionable_reason.description: First applicable reason in the order `package_excluded`, `track_excluded`, `no_actionable_products`; `null` when actionable.

products.title: Products
products.description: Every Product occurrence of the track, including excluded and non-actionable ones, ordered by `product_cpe` (Unicode code point).

TrackStatusTrack.title: TrackStatusTrack
TrackStatusTrack.description: The locked-current track returned by a track-status mutation.

status.description: New affectedness status: `analysis`, `affected`, `not_affected`, `fixed`, or `wont_fix`. `fixed` accepts `admin_ticket_ops` (any Ticket) or `manage_packages` (only a Ticket without a CVE); every other value requires `manage_packages`. Required.

TrackStatusUpdateRequest.title: TrackStatusUpdateRequest
TrackStatusUpdateRequest.description:
Request body of `PATCH .../packages/{package_id}/tracks/{track_id}`.

See `docs/features/packages/package-model.md` (Change Track Status).
The single field is required and non-nullable; an omitted field,
`null`, a non-string, or any value outside the five lowercase
affectedness labels fails with the global `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

TrackSummary.title: TrackSummary
TrackSummary.description:
Counts of the package's actionable tracks by affectedness status.

Only actionable tracks are counted, on the same UTC evaluation date as
the package filtering and pagination of the response.

default_cvss_version.title: Default Cvss Version
default_cvss_version.description: New default CVSS version; exactly 3.1 or 4.0.

UpdateSystemSettingsRequest.title: UpdateSystemSettingsRequest
UpdateSystemSettingsRequest.description:
Request body for `PATCH /api/v1/admin/settings`.

The single field is required (single-field PATCH, `docs/api-spec.md`
Partial Update Semantics): a missing field, `null`, or any value other
than exactly `"3.1"` or `"4.0"` is the global `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.
No preview count, high-water mark, or token is accepted.

UserActionDetailData.title: UserActionDetailData
UserActionDetailData.description:
The `detail` object shared by the password-reset and unlock
action responses (`user-management.md`, Reset User Password / Unlock
User) — a consolidated group per `docs/conventions.md` (Function
Specification Completeness, Consolidated groups): both endpoints
return an identical single-field confirmation shape.

UserData.title: UserData
UserData.description:
The full user profile object shared by `GET /api/v1/users` (list
items) and `GET /api/v1/users/{user}` (`user-management.md`, Get
User). `full_name` and `manager.full_name` are nullable — the API
returns `null` verbatim with no fallback substitution.

UserManagerData.title: UserManagerData
UserManagerData.description:
The `manager` object in a full user profile — the standard User
Reference Object shape plus `email`, per `user-management.md` (Get
User).

UserReference.title: UserReference
UserReference.description:
The standard User Reference Object embedded in response payloads
that reference a user (e.g. `owner`, `revoked_by`).

See `docs/api-spec.md` (User References in Responses): populated
from the *current* `User` row via a JOIN — never a historical
snapshot of the user's profile data at the time of the referenced
event or action.

UserRoleAssignmentData.title: UserRoleAssignmentData
UserRoleAssignmentData.description:
One entry of a full user profile's `roles` array
(`user-management.md`, Get User).

UserRolesUpdateRequest.title: UserRolesUpdateRequest
UserRolesUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/admin/users/{user}/roles`
(`user-management.md`, Set User Roles).

Validation is strict, unlike `user_service.update_roles()`'s permissive
set normalization: an omitted field means `[]`, but explicit `null`, a
non-array, a non-string element, an unknown role value, a role repeated
within one list, and a role present in both lists are rejected. An
absent body is handled by the route as `{}`.

UserSortField.title: UserSortField
UserSortField.description:
Sortable fields for the public user directory list query.

Category B — classification (Python Enum only; never stored in the
database). See `docs/features/identity/user-management.md` (List
Users) for the supported fields and NULL-placement rule for
`full_name`.

loc.title: Loc
loc.description: Path to the invalid input, e.g. `["body", "field_name"]`.

ValidationErrorItem.title: ValidationErrorItem
ValidationErrorItem.description:
One element of the `errors` array of a `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`
body (`docs/api-spec.md`, Response Format).

ValidationErrorResponse.title: ValidationErrorResponse
ValidationErrorResponse.description:
The `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` body: the standard envelope plus the
field-level `errors` array (`docs/api-spec.md`, Response Format).
